dedupe_keys.name: servicio de visualizacion teselado wmts del potencial solar en espana

description: Servicio de visualización teselado (WMTS) del potencial solar en España is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by wmts-potencial-solar.idee.es. Tiled visualization service (WMTS) of the Digital Model of the solar potential, calculated for the entire territory, obtained by applying different calculation algorithms, mainly r.sun. The data source is the Digital Surface Model with a 2m mesh step from the IGN and solar radiation data from the European Commission (PVGIS). Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "View tiled service (WMTS) of solar potential in Spain" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Edificios, IDEE, solar. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2025-07-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
